backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Theiarco backend, implementing CRUD operations for user profiles, publishers, pioneers, territories, shepherding visits, service meeting conductors, field service groups, tasks, and notes, with role-based access control via a MixinAuthorization mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing three required rewrites of PDF export utilities (pioneers, tasks, notes) to use jsPDF and jspdf-autotable instead of HTML/blob-based download logic.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase structure and component responsibilities.
frontend/.env: Frontend environment file that sets the Internet Identity provider URL to https://identity.ic0.app for authentication.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme tokens including colors, sidebar, and chart variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles Internet Identity authentication state and defines all TanStack Router routes for the application, including publishers, pioneers, territories, shepherding, conductors, field service groups, tasks, notes, and user profile pages.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Condu: Modal dialog component for creating and editing trained service meeting conductors, with fields for publisher selection, training date, availability by day of week, status, and notes, supporting both create and edit modes.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Delet: Alert dialog component for confirming deletion of a trained conductor record, using the useDeleteTrainedConductor mutation hook with a loading state indicator.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Att: Display card showing attendance statistics including total publishers and average mid-week/weekend attendance as percentages with progress bars.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Del: Alert dialog for confirming permanent deletion of a meeting attendance record, using the useDeleteMeetingAttendance mutation hook.
Alert dialog for confirming deletion of a group visit record, using the useDeleteGroupVisit mutation hook with toast notifications for success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Gro: Card component displaying a group visit's details including date, discussion topics, publishers present, and notes, with optional edit and delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Rec: Modal dialog for recording or editing meeting attendance, allowing selection of date, meeting type, and which publishers were present, supporting both create and update modes.
Modal dialog for creating or editing a group visit record, with fields for visit date, discussion topics, publishers present, notes, and next planned visit date.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root application layout component composing the sidebar, header, main content outlet, toast notifications, and a global reconnect toast manager.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Top navigation header displaying the app title, a mobile menu toggle button, and a logout button that clears the identity and React Query cache.
frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.t: Renders a responsive sidebar navigation component with themed active/hover states for each route, including a mobile overlay and close button.
frontend/src/components/notes/AddGlobalN: Modal dialog for creating or editing a global note, with fields for title, content, category, and optional publisher attachment.
frontend/src/components/notes/GlobalNote: Displays a single global note as a card with title, category badge, content preview, creation date, and edit/delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/AddPion: Modal dialog for submitting a numeric hours entry for a specific pioneer, month, and service year.
Modal dialog for adding a new pioneer record by selecting an active publisher and a service year.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Current: Displays a badge indicating a pioneer's tracking status (On Track, Behind, or No Entries) based on their average monthly hours for a service year.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/DeleteP: Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a pioneer record, using the delete pioneer mutation and showing success/error toasts.
Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a specific pioneer monthly hours record, with a loading state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/EditPio: A modal dialog component for editing a pioneer's monthly hours record, with form validation and a mutation hook to update the hours.
A modal dialog for editing an existing pioneer's publisher assignment and service year, using a dropdown of active publishers and a mutation hook to persist changes.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Pioneer: A card component that displays a pioneer's total hours, service year average, and current status badge (on-track, behind, no-entries, or loading).
A table row component for a single pioneer that fetches and displays their total hours, average hours, and current status badge, with Edit and Delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/publicWitnessing: An alert dialog that confirms and executes deletion of a trained publisher record using a mutation hook.
A modal form for creating or editing a trained publisher, handling publisher selection, training date, authorization status, and S-148 receipt, with separate create and update mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/publishers/AddPu: A modal form for adding a new publisher with fields for name, field service group, privileges, and role checkboxes, submitting via a mutation hook with toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/publishers/Delet: File content was not provided; likely a confirmation dialog for deleting a publisher note.
frontend/src/components/publishers/EditP: A modal dialog for editing an existing publisher's details including name, field service group, privileges, and active status. Initializes form state from the provided publisher prop and submits updates via the useUpdatePublisher hook.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Edit: A modal dialog for editing an existing shepherding visit, allowing updates to publisher, visit date, and elders present fields. Initializes form from the provided visit prop and submits changes via the useUpdateShepherdingVisit hook.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Reco: A modal dialog for recording a new shepherding visit with fields for publisher, visit date, elders present, and notes. Resets form on close and submits data via the useCreateShepherdingVisit hook.
frontend/src/components/system/Reconnect: A non-rendering component that monitors in-flight queries, mutations, and actor availability to display a persistent 'Reconnecting…' toast when the connection is unavailable, then shows a success toast when restored.
frontend/src/components/tasks/AddTaskMod: A modal dialog for creating a new task with title, due date, category, and optional notes fields. Submits the new task via the useCreateTask hook and resets the form on close.
frontend/src/components/tasks/EditTaskMo: A modal dialog for editing an existing task's title, due date, category, and notes. Initializes form state from the provided task prop and submits updates via the useUpdateTask hook.
frontend/src/components/territories/AddT: Modal dialog for creating a new territory with fields for territory number/name and type, including validation and success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/territories/Chec: Table component displaying a territory's checkout history sorted by most recent, with edit and delete action buttons per row.
Modal dialog for checking out a territory to a publisher, with fields for publisher selection, checkout date, and campaign flag.
frontend/src/components/territories/Dele: Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a specific checkout record from a territory.
Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a territory note.
frontend/src/components/territories/Edit: Modal dialog for editing an existing checkout record, pre-filling publisher, dates, and campaign status, then submitting updates via mutation.
Modal dialog for editing an existing territory's number and type, pre-filling current values and submitting updates via mutation.
Modal dialog for editing an existing territory note, using a textarea and the useUpdateTerritoryNote hook to save changes with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/territories/Terr: Card component that displays a single territory note's content and creation date with edit and delete action buttons.
Section component for a territory's notes page that handles creating, listing, editing, and deleting notes using a textarea composer and note cards.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedPr: A themed primary button component that accepts a themeColor prop and automatically computes a contrasting text color using getContrastColor.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedTa: Provides ThemedTableHeaderRow and ThemedTableHead components that apply a theme color background/text with automatic contrast to table headers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddMeetingAttendan: Mutation hook that records meeting attendance by calling the backend actor with group, date, type, and publisher data, then invalidates the meetingAttendance query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddPublisher.ts: Mutation hook that adds a new publisher to the backend by mapping UI privilege options to backend privilege objects, then invalidates the publishers query cache.
Provides hooks to fetch the current caller's user profile (useGetCallerUserProfile) and save it (useSaveCallerUserProfile), both dependent on the actor being available.
Mutation hook that checks out a territory to a publisher by calling the backend actor with a normalized epoch-seconds date, then invalidates territory-related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGlobalNote.t: Mutation hook that creates a global note with title, content, category, and optional publisher attachment, invalidating the globalNotes query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGroupVisit.t: Mutation hook that submits a new group visit record to the backend and invalidates the groupVisits query cache for the affected group.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePioneer.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new pioneer record via the backend actor and invalidates the pioneers query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateShepherdingV: Mutation hook that creates a shepherding visit record via the backend actor and invalidates the shepherdingVisits query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTask.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new task with title, due date, category, and optional notes via the backend actor, then invalidates all task queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTerritory.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new territory with a generated unique ID, number, and type via the backend actor, then invalidates the territories query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook that calls `addTrainedConductor` on the actor and invalidates the `trainedConductors` cache on success, showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook that creates a trained publisher via `addTrainedPublisher` and optionally sets S-148 status, invalidating the `trainedPublishers` cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCheckoutReco: React Query mutation hook that deletes a territory checkout record by territoryId, publisherId, and date, then invalidates the relevant territory and territories list queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGlobalNote.t: React Query mutation hook that deletes a global note by ID and invalidates the `globalNotes` query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGroupVisit.t: React Query mutation hook that deletes a group visit by visitId and invalidates/removes related group visit cache entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteMeetingAtten: React Query mutation hook that deletes a meeting attendance record by ID, invalidates all `meetingAttendance` queries, and shows toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePioneer.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a pioneer by ID, invalidates the pioneers list, and removes the individual pioneer from the cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePublisher.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a publisher with optimistic UI update, rolling back on error and always refetching the publishers list.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTask.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a task by bigint ID and invalidates all `tasks` queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook that deletes a trained conductor by ID, invalidates the `trainedConductors` cache, and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook that deletes a trained publisher by ID, invalidates the `trainedPublishers` cache, and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalNotes.ts: Provides two React Query hooks: `useGetAllGlobalNotes` for fetching all global notes and `useGetGlobalNote` for fetching a single note by bigint ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisit.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single group visit by visitId from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisits.ts: React Query hook that fetches all group visits for a given group ID, guarding against invalid group IDs.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook managing DFINITY AuthClient login/logout state and identity persistence across page reloads.
React Query hook that fetches meeting attendance records, optionally filtered by group number, from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneerHours.ts: Exports multiple React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and deleting pioneer monthly hours records, each with toast notifications and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneers.ts: Provides two React Query hooks: `useGetAllPioneers` for fetching all pioneers and `useGetPioneer` for fetching a single pioneer by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneersOnTrack.ts: React Query hook that calculates the count of pioneers averaging 50 or more hours per month for a given service year by aggregating all pioneer hours data.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublisherNotes.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides two React Query hooks: `useGetAllPublishers` for fetching all publishers and `useGetPublisher` for fetching a single publisher by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceMeetingCond: React Query hook that fetches all Service Meeting Conductor assignments from the backend actor, returning an empty array while the actor initializes.
frontend/src/hooks/useShepherdingVisit.t: Provides React Query hooks for fetching a single shepherding visit by ID, updating a visit's full record or just its notes, and deleting a visit with cache invalidation.
React Query hook that fetches all shepherding visits from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: React Query hooks for fetching a filtered list of tasks by status and a single task by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritories.ts: React Query hook that fetches all territories from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritory.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching a single territory by ID, updating it, deleting it, marking it returned, and making it available, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritoryNotes.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes associated with a specific territory, with cache invalidation after mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTrainedConductor.t: Provides React Query hooks for fetching a single trained conductor by ID, updating only its notes field, and deleting it with cache invalidation.
React Query hook that fetches all trained Service Meeting Conductors from the backend actor.
React Query hook that fetches all trained publishers from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCheckoutReco: Mutation hook that updates a territory checkout record, normalizing timestamps to epoch seconds before sending to the backend and invalidating territory caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGlobalNote.t: Mutation hook that updates a global note's title, content, category, and optional attached publisher, then invalidates the global notes cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGroupVisit.t: Mutation hook that updates a group visit record on the backend and invalidates related group visit queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateMeetingAtten: Mutation hook that updates a meeting attendance record, converting the meeting date to epoch seconds, with toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePioneer.ts: Mutation hook that edits a pioneer record by ID and invalidates both the pioneers list and single pioneer queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePublisher.ts: Mutation hook that updates a publisher's details, mapping UI privilege selections to backend privilege objects, and invalidates the publishers list on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTask.ts: Mutation hook that updates a task by ID with a new input payload and invalidates all task queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTaskCompleti: Mutation hook that toggles a task's completion status by ID and invalidates all task queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook for updating a trained conductor, invalidating related queries and showing a success toast on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook for updating a trained publisher's details and S-148 status via two separate actor calls, with success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme colors including custom Theiarco brand and dashboard stat card colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ComingSoon.tsx: Simple placeholder page component that displays a 'Coming Soon' message with a construction icon for features under development.
frontend/src/pages/ConductorProfile.tsx: Detail page for a single trained conductor showing their info, editable notes, and options to edit or delete the conductor with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that aggregates and displays stats for publishers, territories, tasks, shepherding visits, meeting attendance, pioneers on track, and global notes.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroupProf: Detail page for a specific field service group showing its publishers, group visits, meeting attendance records, and attendance statistics with modals for recording and editing entries.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroups.ts: Page listing all four field service groups as clickable cards, each showing the group overseer, assistant, and active publishers.
frontend/src/pages/GroupVisitProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile page for a single group visit, showing attendees, discussion topics, and notes, with options to edit or delete the visit via modals/dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Renders the login page for the Theiarco app, providing an Internet Identity authentication button with loading state.
frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx: Displays a filterable list of global notes by category with options to add, edit, delete, and export notes to PDF.
frontend/src/pages/PioneerProfile.tsx: Shows a detailed profile for an individual pioneer including monthly hours tracking with inline editing, add/delete hours modals, and edit/delete pioneer actions.
frontend/src/pages/Pioneers.tsx: Lists all pioneers in a table with actions to add, edit, delete, and export pioneer data to CSV or PDF formats.
frontend/src/pages/PublicWitnessing.tsx: Displays a sorted table of trained public witnessing publishers with authorization status and S-148 form info, supporting add, edit, and delete operations.
frontend/src/pages/PublisherProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile page for a single publisher, showing their attributes and badges, with options to edit or delete the publisher via a modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Publishers.tsx: Renders a filterable, sortable table of all publishers with search, group, and active-status filters, plus add/edit/delete actions via modals and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ServiceMeetingConduct: Displays a sorted table of trained service meeting conductors with add, edit, and delete capabilities, using themed header components and navigation to individual conductor profiles.
frontend/src/pages/Shepherding.tsx: Shows a searchable, date-sorted table of shepherding visits with options to record new visits, edit existing ones, and delete them via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/ShepherdingVisitProfi: Renders a detail page for a single shepherding visit, allowing the user to view and save editable notes, edit visit metadata via a modal, or delete the visit with a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Tasks.tsx: Tasks page component that displays a filterable, sortable table of tasks with support for adding, editing, deleting, and exporting (CSV/PDF) tasks using themed UI components.
frontend/src/pages/Territories.tsx: Territories page that lists all territories in a sortable table with add, edit, delete, and CSV export functionality, using themed UI components and checkout duration helpers.
frontend/src/pages/TerritoryProfile.tsx: Detail page for a single territory showing its checkout history, notes, and status, with modals for editing, checking out, and deleting the territory or its checkout records.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfile.tsx: User profile page allowing inline editing of the user's full name and congregation name, with save/cancel controls and toast notifications.
frontend/src/theme/colorUtils.ts: Utility functions for color manipulation including hex-to-RGB parsing, WCAG luminance calculation, contrast color selection (black/white), and color lightening.
frontend/src/theme/pageTheme.ts: Defines a centralized mapping of page route paths to theme hex colors and provides helper functions to look up the theme color for a given path.
frontend/src/utils/fieldServiceGroupColo: Defines a color mapping for field service groups 1–4 and exports a helper function to retrieve a group's color by number.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Collection of date-formatting utilities that convert backend bigint timestamps (in nanoseconds or seconds) to human-readable date strings for notes, tasks, checkouts, visits, weeks, and training dates.
frontend/src/utils/groupVisitNotes.ts: Defines a parser that extracts structured fields (discussion topics, overseer notes, assistant notes, next visit date) from a combined notes string formatted by RecordGroupVisitModal.
frontend/src/utils/meetingAttendanceStat: Provides utility functions to calculate active publisher counts, average meeting attendance, attendance percentages, and an overview of attendance statistics across all groups.
frontend/src/utils/notesPdfExport.ts: Exports a PDF report of GlobalNote records grouped by category using jsPDF and jspdf-autotable, loaded dynamically from CDN.
frontend/src/utils/pioneersCsvExport.ts: Builds and triggers a CSV download of pioneer service-year data, including monthly hours columns ordered by the September–August service year.
frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts: Exports a landscape PDF report of pioneer service-year data with monthly hours columns using jsPDF and jspdf-autotable, with color-coded status cells.
frontend/src/utils/privilegeBadges.ts: Returns Tailwind CSS class strings for privilege badge styling, mapping 'Elder' to purple and 'Ministerial Servant' to blue.
frontend/src/utils/reconnectState.ts: Implements a singleton observable state class that tracks whether an 'Actor not available' error is active and notifies subscribed listeners on changes.
frontend/src/utils/serviceYear.ts: Calculates and returns the current congregation service year as a 'YYYY-YYYY' string, with the year boundary at September.
frontend/src/utils/tasksCsvExport.ts: Builds and triggers a CSV download of Task records with fields for title, due date, category, status, and notes.
frontend/src/utils/tasksPdfExport.ts: Exports a portrait PDF report of Task records using jsPDF and jspdf-autotable, with color-coded status and title cells based on completion state.
frontend/src/utils/territoryAssignmentRe: Builds and downloads a CSV file in S-13-E Territory Assignment Record format, including territory number, last completion date, and up to 4 recent checkout records per territory.
frontend/src/utils/territoryTime.ts: Provides utility functions for normalizing backend timestamps (handling nanoseconds, milliseconds, and seconds) and calculating checkout durations in days or months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and hash cleanup helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks project state and feature requests, specifically recording three completed tasks to rewrite PDF export utilities (pioneers, tasks, notes) to use jsPDF with jspdf-autotable instead of HTML/blob-based generation.
